strings.jp: 桃太郎は 勇気の剣を{n}海にむかって かざした！{n}{wait}
strings.en: Momotaro held the Sword of Courage up toward the sea!{wait}

strings.jp: 勇気の剣が 輝きはじめた！{n}{n}{wait}
strings.en: The Sword of Courage began to shine!{wait}

strings.jp: 金色の 光が{n}一条の 帯となって{n}海に すいこまれていく…
strings.en: The golden light became a single ribbon and was drawn into the sea...

strings.jp: みるみるうちに{n}海が ひらけ{n}道が できあがった！{wait}
strings.en: Before their very eyes, the sea parted and a path appeared!{wait}

strings.jp: 道は 鬼が島へと{n}続いている…{n}
strings.en: The path leads all the way to Onigashima...
